title: Map resource payload
description: Responsibility-level projection of a Map at honua://maps/{mapId}. Concrete field spellings finalize upstream (honua-server#731); only the stable mapId is pinned and additional properties are permitted. Responsibilities: package format/template binding, source bindings, styling composition, map-spec document, initial view, legend/popup/label composition, artifact bindings. See resources.md §honua://maps/{mapId}.

controls.description: Standard-owned input affordances; the collection `control:{id}` references resolve against (ADR-0031).

explorationContexts.description: Standard-owned units of shared interaction state; the primary interaction model, which components join by naming a context (ADR-0032).

interactions.description: Standard-owned declarative event→action bindings, narrowed by ADR-0032 to one-shot gestures (ADR-0030).
